scares.description: Eve looks through the window and a man pops in-front of it from the other side.
Eve walks up to a rocking baby crib, and upon getting close is grabbed by a hand. [Video]
A bird flies by the window while Eve is looking out of it.
A woman gets hung behind Eve while she is looking the other way.
The man comes back and grabs Eve by her throat.
Someone lights a match and a face appears behind one of the girls.
The room begins sparking from it’s electrical components.
Jean opens her eyes and looks behind to see the woman in black. [Video]
Harry grabs Edward to see that he has a ghost-like face. [Video]
Eve passes a lady who screams at her as she walks by.
Eve looks back at the bed to see the boy has disappeared.
Eve looks back to see no one is there, but then jumps upon seeing a girl as she looks up.
Edward is suddenly pulled under the water while he is walking towards Eve.
The photo breaks revealing the woman in black in it’s reflection. [Video]

title: The Woman in Black 2: Angel of Death
